skill_name: Explain the differences between the Central American countries and the South American countries.
workflow: Central American countries are located in the southern part of North America, south of Mexico and north of South America. They include Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua and Panama. South American countries are located in the southern hemisphere of the American continent, south of Central America and including Colombia, Venezuela, Brazil, Argentina, Peru, Bolivia, Paraguay, Ecuador, Chile, Guyana, Suriname and French Guiana.
